recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black-and-white composition featuring a vast expanse of white negative space in the upper two-thirds, with a gritty, high-contrast photographic scene at the bottom edge. The scene depicts a family on a bicycle in a field, rendered with heavy blacks and blown-out whites, paired with stylized, organic 1970s-era typography in the top-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme vertical division between empty white space and dense bottom imagery
Typographic weight balancing the visual weight of the bottom-right foliage
High-contrast texture in the grass contrasting with the flat white sky

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the bottom 30% of the frame, scaled small to emphasize the vastness of the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the family on the bicycle at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, drops down the vast white space to the bicycle, and follows the horizon line to the right-side foliage.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; over 70% of the canvas is empty white space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Binary value system; no saturation, maximum contrast.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight organic serif with psychedelic influence
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with very thin connectors
Lowercase-only aesthetic for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 's' and 'f' feature elongated, sweeping swashes that curve under or over adjacent letters

composition.scale: Small relative to canvas, large relative to subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using weight and swashes to distinguish lines.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s organic flair and heavy weight
Provides the necessary roundness and weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a family on a vintage bicycle in a grassy field. Apply a threshold filter so there are no grays, only pure black and pure white. Place the scene at the very bottom of a square white canvas, leaving the top 70% entirely empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top-left corner using a heavy, psychedelic 1970s serif font. The text should be solid black and tightly kerned.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochrome with no gray tones?
Is the text positioned in the top-left corner?
Is the subject restricted to the bottom third of the frame?

adjustableVariables: Vertical position of the horizon line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the people
Exact brand logos on the bicycle
Specific wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray pixels exist in the final output
Check that the text does not touch the edges of the frame
Confirm the bottom scene feels like a gritty film capture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-threshold bottom-aligned photographic silhouette with a top-left aligned heavy swash-serif display face on a pure white field.
